Six ways to meet

A session is slow and simple. We start by arriving, then find together what your body and heart are asking for today. You can say yes or no to anything, at any moment.

  • Eye gazing 深情的眼神交流

    Resting in each other's eyes, without needing to say anything.

  • Flow movement 自由流動的身體律動

    Letting the body move the way it wants to move.

  • Gentle touch 溫柔觸碰

    Calm, caring hands, always with your consent.

  • Loving sound 愛的頌缽

    Singing bowls and voice, felt through the whole body.

  • Deep hugging 深度擁抱

    A long, unhurried hug, held for as long as feels right.

  • Deep listening 完全接納的深度傾聽

    Being heard completely, with nothing to fix.

Wherever you are

Loving Connection happens in markets, gardens, living rooms and friends' studios. I can also come to you.

House calls

Your home, your office, a park or a station. For the anxious Monday morning, after school drop-off, or a lunch-break reset.

Pop-up days

Come find me at markets and co-hosted days around Taipei. No booking needed.

Friends' spaces

Sessions in studios and homes that friends open to this work.

Eye-gazing parties

An evening of eye gazing with a small group, every few weeks.

Hi, I'm Alex

I trained as a lawyer and worked for eight years as a community mediator. About fourteen years ago, in Vietnam, my heart opened. I realized that since I was very small, I had been sending all my feelings through my mind.

Since then I've been learning, slowly, to live from the heart. I've lived in Taiwan for more than twelve years. This year I left teaching to give my time fully to Loving Connection.

I offer it by donation because it feels truer to me than a price. Give what feels right.
